$schema_note: Machine-readable style for the renderer. The renderer reads style ONLY from here (no hardcoded values). Units: px are at the 1080x1920 output; times in seconds; colours hex. Each value carries its measurement source in style/STYLE.md. 'looks' are the three visual families found in the references; scenes pick one (default_look).

safe_area._note: Instagram Reels UI: top bar, bottom caption/username, right action column. Reference titles sit at y 0.13-0.22 of height (250-420 px), CTA pill top at ~0.07-0.12.

grade._measured: basemap mean brightness 0.24-0.32, saturation 0.23-0.25 (r1, r6); the grade turns stock satellite imagery (brightness ~0.40, sat ~0.45) into that

focus_dim._measured: r1: everything outside the city boundary is darker; r2: outside the NYC boroughs

region_tint._measured: r2: highlighted region is the satellite image tinted blue (texture stays visible), sampled #0F688E-#1689B8

route._measured: stroke 9.6-10.1 px at 720 wide (r1, r6) = 14-15 px at 1080; colours = median core pixels

label_pill._measured: r1/r6 station labels: yellow box, black text, small pointer under it

title._measured: r2 'New york' / 'Metro' (27 / 48 px glyph height at 1920 -> font ~40 / ~72); r6 'Pink line' white, cy 0.18, slowly scales up

title_on_map._measured: r1 'Rapid Metro' white bold over the map, above the route, from ~0.3 s

stat._measured: r1 '11 Stations' yellow + '11.7 KM' green (glyph h 72 px at 1920); r6 '45 Stations' #EFCE20 + '71.5 KM' #2EF728; r2 stat words white with yellow numbers

stat_inline._measured: r2 '25 Subway Services / 472 Metro Stations / 399 KM': numbers yellow, words white, regular weight

grade._measured: basemap mean brightness 0.30-0.41, saturation 0.59-0.62: vivid, untouched satellite

region_fill._measured: r4 India #008BFE (exact); states and continents flat saturated fills; r3 continents with thin red outline + glow; country names white caps

route._measured: r4 NH44: thin dark dotted line along the highway

big_text._measured: r4 'NH 44' rotated along the route, 'WORLD' + red ribbon '22nd longest highway'

grade._measured: basemap mean brightness 0.18, saturation 0.07: greyscale terrain relief

region_fill._measured: r5 Sikkim neon green #25B928-#33D03C with wide outer glow; districts in flat categorical fills

headline._measured: r5 'WORLD'S FIRST ORGANIC STATE' bold italic serif, green / white / lime words

fonts._note: Reference look A uses Apple SF Pro (licence limits it to Apple-platform UI work), so the free Inter (OFL) stands in; look B is Poppins (OFL); look C headline is a bold italic display serif, Playfair Display (OFL) is the closest free match. If the editor's actual font files are put in inputs/assets/fonts, they replace these.

text_in._measured: sync strips: text starts 0.0-0.2 s after the word onset, characters revealed left->right, complete ~0.4 s later

label_in._measured: r1 'Millennium City' pill appears +0.2 s and grows

fill_in._measured: r4 states pop instantly one by one on each spoken name; r2/r5 fade

route_draw._measured: r6 Pink line draws in ~1.2 s from frame 0; r1 Yellow Line ~1 s

camera._measured_lead: move start minus nearest word start: median 0.02 s over 37 moves (r2-r5); range -0.3..+0.25

metro_dark._measured: r1/r6 moves: zoom x1.2-2.0 over 3.5-6.5 s, progress at 50% time = 0.56-0.75 (near-linear with a soft ease-out); camera keeps drifting between moves

bright_political._measured: r4: 8/13 moves best fit easeInOutSine, 1.6-3 s

hillshade_glow._measured: r5: punch-ins, 50% of the zoom done in the first 20-25% of the move

plan._note: How the planner turns entities into camera moves and overlays. Fractions are of the 1080x1920 frame.

fit._measured: r1: Gurugram fills ~0.75 of the width at t=0; Rapid Metro spans ~0.45 of the height at t=6

facecam._measured: r1, r2, r5, r6: last 12-17 s are the creator on camera; r3 intercuts 1.5-6 s face-cam bits through the reel; r4 has none

broll._measured: r2 subway footage full-frame with the spoken stat on top; r5 farm photos as stacked rounded cards with a soft green glow

edit.hook: subject on screen from frame 0, camera already moving, title types in by 0.2-0.5 s; no title card

comment_pill._measured: r4 last ~3 s, over the map

voice._measured: integrated -14.1..-14.3 LUFS, LRA 1.1-3.1 LU on all six reels

music_bed._measured: r2, r6: no bed (no energy under 90 Hz); r1, r4, r5: a quiet bed; level to be set by ear against r1/r4

sfx._measured: no whoosh/pop on every zoom; r3 uses a few bass impacts on reveals

branding._measured: only r5 shows '@creator.adarshh' (small, ~35% opacity); others none

captions._measured: no running subtitles in any reference; only keyword / number / place popups
